name: remvu
description: Portable project memory with a standalone engine, observable recording and save/resume.

interface.longDescription: Carry project intent, constraints, rejected approaches and unfinished work between coding agents. The complete standalone engine bundles its runtime and preserves observable recording, code fingerprints, concurrent updates and private sharing boundaries. Save and resume are the everyday actions. Hidden reasoning is excluded; see platform-specific validation evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Remvu save to prepare a local handoff, or resume to continue from one.
